title.narrative: Second Strengthening Social Resilience Program (Subprogram 1)

description.narrative: The Government of Bangladesh has committed social protection as one of its most prioritized agenda. The government formulated the National Social Security Strategy (NSSS) in 2015 to provide a long-term vision of developing an inclusive social protection system. Aligned with the NSSS, Asian Development Bank (ADB) provided the first Strengthening Social Resilience Program (SSRP) in 2021 to enhance inclusiveness and responsiveness of social protection in Bangladesh. The first SSRP helped the government increase the coverage of social protection, improve financial inclusion of disadvantaged people, and strengthen response to diverse protection needs. Building on the first SSRP's achievements, the proposed program will further support the government in enhancing protective and preventive social protection, aligned with Phase II Action Plan of NSSS (2021-2026).

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jan 01, 2023 - May 31, 2024

description.narrative:
Action 1: MOSW adopted a policy to consolidate the cash-based programs for persons with disabilities administered by DSS from two programs to one program to improve administrative efficiency in social protection program management. Target date: 2024-05-31
Action 2: MOSW adopted and commenced Bangladesh's first scheme to verify if beneficiaries are alive or deceased for all cash-based social protection programs, administered by DSS, to minimize leakage and misuse of social protection resources and to improve overall efficiency in social protection program management. Target date: 2024-05-31
Action 3: CCSSP approved an increase in the monthly allowance of WA by 10%, and the Cabinet approved raising the income threshold of WA's eligibility criteria, to provide protection commensurate with inflation and economic conditions. Target date: 2024-05-31
